payload.text: Evidence on both sides — weighing raw throughput against developer velocity.

payload.content:
For a high-throughput API server, **Rust** is the stronger pick on raw performance: memory safety without garbage collection, and an async ecosystem (Tokio, hyper) built for very high-throughput network services. **Python** with asyncio and FastAPI handles I/O-bound workloads well and wins on developer velocity and ecosystem, but the GIL limits CPU-bound parallelism and raw throughput trails compiled languages.

Pick Rust when throughput is the hard requirement; pick Python when iteration speed matters more than the last order of magnitude.
